name: superkitchen
description: Meal planning for families and friends: meal plan, own recipes, pantry and a shared shopping list.

interface.longDescription:
"What are we eating today?" is the question nobody wants to answer at 5 pm, and the shopping list is never where you need it. Superkitchen is the app for families and friends who plan meals together: your own recipes, a shared meal plan, a pantry if you like, and one shopping list for everyone. Plan, shop, cook smart.

With Superkitchen in ChatGPT you can:
- Ask "What are we cooking today?" ChatGPT reads your meal plan and who cooks.
- Plan the week from your own recipes, using what you have at home. ChatGPT adds the dishes once you agree.
- Put everything you're missing for a recipe on the shared shopping list.
- Say what ran out, and the pantry is up to date again.
- Save a recipe from a website or a photo as a draft in Superkitchen.

Changes show up for the whole family right away in the Superkitchen app on iPhone, Android and in the browser, and the others get notified.

What you need: a Superkitchen account and an adult role in your kitchen (owner, chef or sous chef). When you connect, you choose which kitchen ChatGPT may use. Deleting recipes and everything about your account stays in the app. Disconnect anytime in Superkitchen under Settings › Assistants, or in ChatGPT.
defaultPrompt: Plan our dinners for next week from our own recipes.
Put what we need for tonight's dinner on the shopping list.

positive.description: Read today's meal plan of the test kitchen.
positive.prompt: What are we cooking today in Superkitchen?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the dish or dishes planned for today in the kitchen "Testküche Web" and who cooks (on Saturdays the plan says leftovers), matching the meal plan in the Superkitchen app. No changes are made.

positive.description: Add items to the shared shopping list.
positive.prompt: Put milk and eggs on the Superkitchen shopping list.
positive.expected_behavior: Milk and eggs are on the shopping list of the test kitchen (visible with get_shopping_list and in the app at app.getsuperkitchen.com), and ChatGPT confirms both items.

positive.description: Plan an own recipe on a given day.
positive.prompt: Add our recipe Pfannkuchen to the meal plan for next Friday.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT finds the recipe "Pfannkuchen" and adds it to next Friday (as an additional dish if that day is already planned), then confirms the date and the dish.

positive.description: Suggest own recipes based on the pantry.
positive.prompt: Which of our Superkitchen recipes can I cook with what we have at home?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists recipes from the test kitchen and says for each which ingredients are at home according to the pantry. No changes are made.

positive.description: Save a recipe given in the chat as a draft.
positive.prompt: Save this recipe as a draft in Superkitchen: Tomato soup for 4. 1 kg tomatoes, 1 onion, 500 ml vegetable stock, salt. Chop the onion, cook everything for 20 minutes, blend.
positive.expected_behavior: A draft recipe "Tomato soup" with the four ingredients and the steps is saved in the test kitchen, and ChatGPT says the family can review the draft in the app.

negative.description: Deleting recipes is not possible through the plugin.
negative.prompt: Delete our recipe Pasta Bolognese in Superkitchen.
negative.expected_behavior: No recipe is deleted. ChatGPT explains that recipes can only be deleted in the Superkitchen app.

negative.description: Subscriptions and credits are not handled by the plugin.
negative.expected_behavior: No tool is called. ChatGPT explains that subscriptions are managed in the Superkitchen app.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Berlin tomorrow?
negative.expected_behavior: The Superkitchen plugin is not used.

publication.release_notes: First release: meal plan, own recipes, pantry, wishes and the shared shopping list of a Superkitchen kitchen.

de-DE.subtitle: App für Familien und Freunde
de-DE.description:
„Was essen wir heute?“ fragt um fünf Uhr keiner gern, und die Einkaufsliste liegt nie da, wo man sie braucht. Superkitchen ist die App für Familien und Freunde, die gemeinsam planen: eigene Rezepte, ein gemeinsamer Essensplan, auf Wunsch ein Vorrat und eine Einkaufsliste für alle. Smart planen, einkaufen, kochen.

Mit Superkitchen in ChatGPT:
- „Was kochen wir heute?“ ChatGPT schaut in euren Essensplan und weiß, wer kocht.
- Die Woche aus euren eigenen Rezepten planen, mit dem, was zuhause ist. ChatGPT trägt die Gerichte ein, sobald du zustimmst.
- Alles, was für ein Rezept fehlt, auf die gemeinsame Einkaufsliste setzen.
- Sagen, was alle ist, und der Vorrat stimmt wieder.
- Ein Rezept von einer Website oder einem Foto als Entwurf in Superkitchen speichern.

Änderungen sieht die ganze Familie sofort in der Superkitchen-App auf iPhone, Android und im Browser, die anderen bekommen eine Mitteilung.

Was du brauchst: ein Superkitchen-Konto und eine erwachsene Rolle in deiner Küche (Owner, Chef oder Sous Chef). Beim Verbinden wählst du, welche Küche ChatGPT nutzen darf. Rezepte löschen und alles rund ums Konto bleibt in der App. Trennen geht jederzeit in Superkitchen unter Einstellungen › Assistenten oder in ChatGPT.
